nodes.name: sklearn.ensemble.forest_path_outputs
nodes.description: Deterministic output formatting for sklearn forest apply and decision_path after per-tree callbacks are already resolved.

nodes.name: forest_apply_leaf_matrix
nodes.description: Transpose one leaf-index vector per estimator into sklearn's sample-major forest apply matrix.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The function executes in constant time and space as it only performs simple validation checks, variable assignments, or returns inputs.

nodes.name: forest_decision_path_node_ptr
nodes.description: Compute cumulative estimator-column offsets from supplied per-tree decision-path indicator widths.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The function executes in constant time and space as it only performs simple validation checks, variable assignments, or returns inputs.

nodes.name: forest_decision_path_csr
nodes.description: Horizontally stack supplied per-tree decision-path indicators and return CSR output.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The function executes in constant time and space as it only performs simple validation checks, variable assignments, or returns inputs.

notes: Per-tree apply and decision_path callbacks remain deferred.
This family only covers the deterministic reduction and formatting of already-computed tree outputs.
